prompts.shura_poet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down RPG stage background, pixel art. Create ONE landscape 3:2 image, an empty roofless interior map seen from a fixed near-top-down orthographic JRPG view, logical canvas 768x512, 32 pixel tile scale, designed for separate 32x48 pixel characters. Scene: shura_poet, a storm-dark ruined overseas academy gallery in an alternate 1900 Chinese empire. 40% Chinese westernized natural science academy, 40% Victorian industry, 20% Hermetic geometry. Walnut and nanmu paneling, restrained cinnabar lacquer screens, verdigris copper pipes, ivory plaster, broken smoky tuff arch at rear, rain beyond windows. Compose wide unobstructed central floor from x160 to608,y200 to416 for live characters; furniture only perimeter, bottom edge open floor. Small furniture should fit human scale. Top-down tile-compatible perspective, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, readable low noise floor, beautiful restrained lighting, warm lamp #F2D091, palette ivory #EAE0C4/cinnabar #8A3324/teal #2A6F68. No people, no silhouettes, no words, no UI, no captions, no swords or characters painted into background. No purple or cold gold, no pure black or amber accents. No isometric perspective, no photo textures, no perspective vanishing point. The scene is a usable game map rather than concept illustration.
prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art RPG modular terrain source atlas. Generate one 1024x1024 opaque image as an EXACT 4 by 4 equal-cell grid, each cell exactly 256 by 256 output pixels. NO gutters, NO labels, NO grid overlay. Each cell depicts one seamless tile material, drawn on an EXACT 32 by 32 pixel grid and enlarged 8x with hard nearest-neighbor pixel edges. Every 8x8 block is one flat pixel colour. A true 32-pixel tile game asset, no subpixel texture, no antialiasing, no dithering noise. Top-down flat surfaces only, no objects, no perspective. Row 1 cells: ivory square academy floor tile with thin teal trim; muted teal-green ceramic floor; warm walnut horizontal floor planks; pale nanmu planks. Row 2: ancient dark blue-gray basalt hexagon paving; charcoal obsidian stone with a small subtle spiral incision; smoky gray tuff masonry blocks; dark wrought-iron riveted plate. Row 3: calm muted blue-gray tidal water ripples; pale shallow water ripples; dangerous source essence in deep purple #6B3FA0 with sparse cold-gold #C8B456 fluid veins; dark wet shoreline stone. Row 4: ivory plaster wall; cinnabar #8A3324 lacquer wall panel; teal #2A6F68 painted wood wall panel; weathered warm stone paving. Every swatch seamlessly repeats on all four edges, texture features crossing one edge continue exactly on opposite edge. Alternate 1900 Chinese overseas academy visual language. Keep each cell flat, restrained readable colour texture. Pure black #0E0C10 and amber #D9A13A forbidden. Purple and cold gold ONLY in row3 col3 essence tile. No white page margin, no cast shadows, no mockup.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production pixel art RPG object atlas. Create one SQUARE PNG, true TRANSPARENT alpha background. Arrange exactly TWELVE separate game objects in a regular 4 columns by 3 rows grid, with generous transparent gutters and no overlap, NO TEXT OR LABELS. Each cell square, all objects complete and centered. Perspective: classic top-down 3/4 JRPG, looking down at the object, no isometric tilt. Style: deliberate chunky 32px tile pixel art, hard square colour pixels, not smooth illustration. Logical object sizes one or two 32px tiles wide, 32x48 humanoid game scale. Alternate 1900 Chinese overseas academy, 40% westernized Chinese science /40% Victorian industrial/20% Hermetic geometry. Row1 left to right: (1) two-leaf ivory plaster and nanmu doorway with dark empty opening, brass handles and restrained cinnabar trim (2) tall mullioned academy WINDOW in wooden frame, blue gray glass (3) walnut KITCHEN WORKTABLE with wooden board, pale flour, small bowls, pork-and-cabbage filling and rows of pale crescent dumplings, table top visible (4) dark wrought iron COOKSTOVE with two stacked bamboo steamer baskets, no steam drawn. Row2 left to right: (5) ancient OBSIDIAN STELE on basalt foot, carved spiral sea-folk motifs, no writing, tall (6) heavy smoked-tuff ruined ARCH, open center and wrought iron braces (7) three neatly stacked WOODEN GRAIN CRATES and two cream cloth sacks (8) shallow wooden SEEDLING TRAY with healthy small green seedlings. Row3 left to right: (9) a walnut GO TABLE with plain undecorated honey coloured square board, NO GRID and NO STONES (software overlays exact19x19 grid) (10) old copper pipe valve ENGINE mechanism bolted to a compact base (11) a tall dark green and cinnabar LACQUER SCREEN with understated warm brass edging (12) a slender old-fashioned STEEL SWORD as separate pickup prop. Colour palette ivory #EAE0C4, cinnabar #8A3324, teal #2A6F68, warm wood, gray steel. No purple, no cold gold, no pure black #0E0C10, no amber #D9A13A. No humans, no floor rectangle beneath props, no generated shadows outside object footprint. Truly transparent background, no checker pattern painted in.
prompts.cast: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production RPG character sprite sheet on genuinely transparent background. Exact grid THREE COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 12 separate full body figures, every figure centered in its own cell, large transparent gutters, all feet same baseline within row, no overlap. Columns represent front view, rear view, left profile of exactly same character in that row. Four rows: Row1 LUCIEN, young European male poet, wavy brown hair, torn dark burgundy velvet cloak over cream 1900 shirt and dark trousers, a slender steel rapier held safely low. Row2 GU PINGZHANG, Chinese scholar aged59, tied gray hair, modest beard, royal BLUE Confucian long scholar robe with cream collar, dignified. Row3 RUAN QINGYUE, Chinese woman aged19, long dark hair, plain WHITE cloak over modest pale-gray period dress, chess player. Row4 ONE demon caretaker, elegant tall slender male-looking silhouette, pure black #0E0C10 1900 tailcoat, pale gray face, amber #D9A13A eyes and a small delicate amber chain; no horns, no wings, no duplication within cell. Classic crisp JRPG pixel sprites, designed on 32x48 pixel sprite cell, 3.5 to 4 heads tall, no superdeformed huge heads, hard square pixels. Render the logical pixels at large integer magnification with no anti-aliasing and no tiny texture noise, readable silhouette. All characters fully inside their cells. Straight orthographic game view, no isometric tilt. Transparent alpha background, no drawn checkerboard, no floor, no oval shadows, no text, no labels. Purple and cold gold forbidden, pure black and amber exclusive to demon row4.
